tiers.name: Primary / Authoritative
tiers.description: Statutory registries, impact assessment records, federal and provincial gazettes, CanadaBuys tenders, CER filings, Crown corporations.

tiers.name: Corporate Issuers & Regulatory Filings
tiers.description: SEDAR+ disclosures, stock exchange filings (TSX), audited annual financial statements, official proponent press releases.

tiers.name: Credible News Organizations
tiers.description: Major investigative and business journalism organizations with professional editorial standards.

tiers.name: Secondary Industry Research
tiers.description: Trade association newsletters, consultancy reports, academic working papers.

tiers.name: Community / Unverified Lead
tiers.description: Discovery-only leads that may identify a primary source but cannot establish canonical truth or CEGS Evidence without corroboration.
